work.title: jk (bad canon for four violins)
work.notes: Original for four violins; recorded as a human multitrack by Yuka Matsumoto.

sources.locator: Cached revision 3597045; WORK INFO and FILES
sources.finding: Original work; IMSLP instrumentation says “4 violins or any 4 identical treble instruments.” One file is labeled Complete Score; complete notation is inspected in the cached PDF.

Composer describes a brief work for four violins (or four identical treble instruments), gives first performance by Yuka Matsumoto on all four parts in April 2020 in Japan, and credits “Yuka Matsumoto, violins (multitracked).” Bandcamp lists album release October 23, 2012, whereas track title includes 2017; exact score title page bears “7/4/17-7/5/17.” Year omitted pending reconciliation.
